mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, we are looking at clear skies and 63 degrees near Fireman's Park, with a waning gibbous moon shining down tonight.

The city reminds everyone that alternate-side winter parking regulations go into effect from November 20 through April 1 to ensure effective snow removal. Also, please note that the Verona Senior Center will be closed on November 26 and 27 for the Thanksgiving holiday.
Today, you can participate in yoga at Insight Wellness, enjoy Thursday night festivities at ART House 360, or join the trivia competition at Hop Haus Brewing Company.
In a noteworthy call for service on October 23, two juveniles were cited for riding prohibited eMotos after a previous warning.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is OREO REESE'S Cheesecake. The store is currently open and will remain open until 10 PM this evening.
